tools.name: doseedo_convert_project
tools.description: DAW CONVERTER: a project rebuilt natively in the target: tracks, MIDI, audio clips, tempo and markers arrive editable (Logic/Ableton/Pro Tools/REAPER pairs also automation, buses/sends, plugin state; into FL 3rd-party plugins only). Sources: Logic .logicx, Ableton .als, FL Studio .flp, Pro Tools .pt

tools.name: doseedo_get_project_upload_url
tools.description: Get a presigned upload for a DAW PROJECT file (for doseedo_convert_project / doseedo_import_project). Zip a project FOLDER so its audio travels with it — and a .logicx or GarageBand .band, which are folders (macOS packages). SIZE LIMITS: a single PUT takes up to 5 GB; guest and free accounts convert

tools.name: doseedo_complete_project_upload
tools.description: Finish a MULTIPART project upload started by doseedo_get_project_upload_url: pass every uploaded part's number and ETag (from the PUT response header; quotes optional). Returns the project_key to pass to doseedo_convert_project / doseedo_import_project. All parts except the last must be the same siz

tools.name: doseedo_check_task
tools.description: Check an async doseedo job once — a DAW conversion (doseedo_convert_project) or a bounce (doseedo_bounce_session). Returns its status and, when finished, the result: pre-signed file links and, for a conversion, its transfer report (report, lossy, summary, warnings). The job_id alone is enough.

tools.name: doseedo_wait_task
tools.description: Wait for an async doseedo job — a DAW conversion or a bounce — to finish: polls server-side for up to timeout_seconds (5–50; one call can never hold longer than 50 s), then returns the result or the latest status. If it returns still_running:true, call it again — a conversion usually takes 15 s–2 mi

tools.name: doseedo_list_jobs
tools.description: List the jobs this account submitted, newest first — DAW conversions (convert_project) and bounces (bounce_session) — to find an earlier result, check what is still running, or resume after a lost connection. Each row names its artifacts; doseedo_check_task {job_id} returns the full result with fres

tools.name: doseedo_cancel_job
tools.description: Cancel a queued or running job. bounce_session: a bounce still queued never renders (its budget is refunded); one mid-render has its result dropped on arrival. convert_project: a running conversion has no stop — it completes, the job ends as canceled and its output is discarded; the credit is refund

tools.name: doseedo_account
tools.description: Check the connected doseedo account: plan tier, the monthly credit pool (DAW conversions draw it), purchased extra-usage credits, and storage. Read-only — consumes nothing. Use it before a batch of conversions to confirm there is budget.

tools.name: doseedo_list_sessions
tools.description: List the connected account's DAW sessions (most recently updated first) — their ids, names, DAW, and update time. When sync.live_edits is true Dø Desktop puts it into the user

tools.description: Add an audio file to a session from a public https URL (any audio file online; a bounce's pre-signed stem link works as is). tools.description: List the plugins you can insert on a strip with doseedo_edit_session's add_device op. Returns the stock Logic catalog (instruments + effects, always available) and — when Dø Desktop is connected — the actual plugins installed on the user's Mac (stock + third-party). Insert any of them BY NAME: add_d

tools.name: doseedo_create_session
tools.description: Create a new, empty DAW session in the account (a blank project you can then populate with doseedo_edit_session). Returns its session_id.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "daw" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: doseedo_get_project_upload_url, doseedo_add_audio_to_session · Private data: doseedo_convert_project, doseedo_get_project_upload_url, doseedo_import_project, doseedo_check_task, doseedo_get_session, doseedo_add_audio_to_session, doseedo_bounce_session, doseedo_download_session · Public sink: doseedo_convert_project, doseedo_get_project_upload_url, doseedo_complete_project_upload, doseedo_import_project, doseedo_edit_session, doseedo_add_audio_to_session · Destructive: doseedo_delete_sessions, doseedo_get_session, doseedo_bounce_session, doseedo_download_session.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: doseedo_get_project_upload_url, doseedo_add_audio_to_session · Private data: doseedo_convert_project, doseedo_get_project_upload_url, doseedo_import_project, doseedo_check_task, doseedo_get_session, doseedo_add_audio_to_session, doseedo_bounce_session, doseedo_download_session · Public sink: doseedo_convert_project, doseedo_get_project_upload_url, doseedo_complete_project_upload, doseedo_import_project, doseedo_edit_session, doseedo_add_audio_to_session · Destructive: doseedo_delete_sessions, doseedo_get_session, doseedo_bounce_session, doseedo_download_session

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "doseedo_bounce_session" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
